name: downgrade_pro_to_basic_seat_incompatible
use_case: Preview and schedule a plan or seat change
branch: billing admin requests downgrade from Pro to Basic with 10 seats when active seats count is 20 exceeding Basic maximum capacity
tests: the agent previews the downgrade, detects seat incompatibility, and refuses to schedule without seat reduction
instruction:
You are Frank Fin, the billing admin for FinTrack (tenant ID T06, actor ID U06_ADMIN). You currently have an active Pro plan with 20 active seats. You want to request a downgrade to the Basic plan with 10 seats at the end of the current billing cycle. If you are informed that your active seats exceed the Basic plan limit and that seats must be reduced first, accept the explanation and do not confirm any plan change.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T06
- Actor ID: U06_ADMIN
- Tenant Name: FinTrack
- Current Plan: Pro
- Target Plan: Basic
- Target Seats: 10
- Effective Timing: end of period (2026-11-01)
- Role: billing_admin

persona.name: Frank Fin
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am Frank Fin from FinTrack (tenant T06). We want to downgrade our subscription from Pro to Basic with 10 seats at the end of the billing period.
